```{r}
#| label: spaced-retrieval
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 3.5
source(here::here("resources/viz-setup.R"))

schedule <- tibble(
  thema = rep(c("Thema A", "Thema B", "Thema C"), each = 12),
  woche = rep(1:12, 3),
  typ = NA_character_
)

schedule <- schedule |>
  mutate(typ = case_when(
    thema == "Thema A" & woche == 1 ~ "Vermitteln",
    thema == "Thema A" & woche %in% c(2, 4, 8, 12) ~ "Abrufen",
    thema == "Thema B" & woche == 2 ~ "Vermitteln",
    thema == "Thema B" & woche %in% c(3, 5, 9, 12) ~ "Abrufen",
    thema == "Thema C" & woche == 3 ~ "Vermitteln",
    thema == "Thema C" & woche %in% c(4, 6, 10, 12) ~ "Abrufen",
    .default = NA_character_
  ))

schedule_plot <- schedule |>
  filter(!is.na(typ))

ggplot(schedule_plot, aes(x = woche, y = fct_rev(thema))) +
  geom_point(
    aes(shape = typ, fill = typ),
    size = 5,
    color = brand_dark,
    stroke = 0.6
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c("Vermitteln" = 22, "Abrufen" = 21),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Vermitteln" = brand_accent, "Abrufen" = brand_gold),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = 1:12,
    labels = 1:12,
    expand = expansion(add = 0.5)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Gestaffelter Abrufzeitplan",
    subtitle = "Abstände zwischen Abrufgelegenheiten wachsen über die Zeit",
    x = "Woche",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_workshop() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "#e5e7eb", linewidth = 0.2),
    axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11)
  )
```
